_readme: MANUAL / CURATED LAYER. For firms whose sites can't be reliably scraped (heavy SPA, WAF/Cloudflare blocking, or a poor interface), hand-add articles here and they still appear on the site. Shape: a top-level key is the EXACT firm name (must match the adapter's name, e.g. 'Norton Rose Fulbright'); its value is an ARRAY of entries. Each entry: { title (required), url (required, the full article link), date ('10 July 2026' or any common format) OR dateISO ('2026-07-10'), topic (string) OR topics (array of strings), teaser (optional one-line blurb), notes (optional). Manual entries are deep-merged in, deduped by URL (manual wins on collision), and tagged 'manual' on the site. Keys beginning with underscore are ignored.

Norton Rose Fulbright.title: Example: ACCC steps up merger enforcement in 2026
Norton Rose Fulbright.teaser: Short one-line description shown under the row.
Norton Rose Fulbright.notes: Example only — inside _example so it is ignored. Copy this shape under a real firm-name key to activate.
